high_level_description: The image is a meme that discusses the aging of special effects in films and the use of makeup and disguises to avoid it. The top part of the image contains text explaining that the aging of special effects is often due to the desire of directors to use ephemeral technologies that were cutting-edge at the time but quickly became outdated. The main focus of the image is a still from the movie "The Mummy Returns," released in 2001.
